"Time Is Love" is a song written by Tony Martin, Mark Nesler and Tom Shapiro and recorded by American country music artist Josh Turner.
It was released in January 2012 as the lead-off single from Turner's album Punching Bag.
It was covered by Mark Kozelek on his 2013 covers album Like Rats.
Joshua Otis Turner (born November 20, 1977) is an American country singer and songwriter.
In 2003, he signed to MCA Nashville Records.
That same year, his debut album's title track, "Long Black Train", was his breakthrough single release.
